fees.title: Transparent, estimated fees

whatIsProxy.a: You tell us which Japanese card you want; we buy it locally in Japan on your behalf, then forward it to you in the U.S. It's the way to reach sellers and marketplaces that don't ship internationally.

whichMarketplaces.q: Which marketplaces can I buy from?
whichMarketplaces.a: Mercari Japan and Yahoo Auctions are live today, with Amazon Japan and Surugaya coming soon. You can also share a listing link from a supported marketplace.

feesHow.a: Fees include the item price, a service fee and shipping. Every figure is an estimate shown before you order; see the Fees page for the full, estimated breakdown.

condition.q: How do I know the card's condition?
condition.a: We translate the seller's Japanese condition notes into English and take inspection photos of the actual card before it ships.

shippingTime.a: Timing depends on the seller and your chosen shipping method. Consolidating multiple orders into one parcel is the most cost-effective option.
